zh: 週三美股三大指數小幅收高：標普 500 上漲 0.28% 收 7,743.98，那斯達克上漲 0.27% 收 26,549.85，道瓊上漲 0.19% 收 52,475.10，羅素 2000 上漲 0.41% 收 2,830.51。聯準會維持利率不變，但有兩位官員主張升息，十年期殖利率升到約 5.05%；VIX 下降 3.48% 至 16.91。不同來源的收盤數字差在個位數，這裡採用 Yahoo Finance 的即時快照。
en: US stocks edged higher on Wednesday: the S&P 500 rose 0.28% to 7,743.98, the Nasdaq gained 0.27% to 26,549.85, the Dow added 0.19% to 52,475.10 and the Russell 2000 gained 0.41% to 2,830.51. The Fed held rates but two officials wanted a hike, and the 10-year yield rose to about 5.05%; the VIX fell 3.48% to 16.91. Sources differ by a few points on the closing prints; these figures come from Yahoo Finance's live snapshot.

stocks.n: 標普 500 ETF，週三 +0.28%
那斯達克 100 ETF，那斯達克 +0.27%
羅素 2000 ETF，小型股 +0.41%

zh: 個股兩極：Vertiv 大漲 16.6%，因為第三季營收年增 61%，並把全年營收預期上調 6.5 億美元；甲骨文約漲 12%，提出 2030 財年營收至少 2,250 億美元、2029 財年自由現金流超過 300 億美元的目標。下跌的有 Enphase（-16.0%，第四季營收預估 2.25 億至 2.55 億美元）與 F5（-20.4%，2027 財年營收成長預估 8% 至 9%，原本 11%）。
en: Stocks split sharply: Vertiv jumped 16.6% after third-quarter sales rose 61% and it lifted its full-year sales outlook by $650 million; Oracle rose about 12% after targeting at least $225 billion of revenue in fiscal 2030 and free cash flow above $30 billion in fiscal 2029. On the downside, Enphase fell 16.0% on a fourth-quarter sales guide of $225 million to $255 million, and F5 fell 20.4% on fiscal 2027 revenue growth guidance of 8% to 9%, down from 11%.

stocks.n: Vertiv，+16.6%，資料中心電力與散熱
甲骨文，約 +12%，給出 2030 財年營收目標
Enphase，-16.0%，第四季營收預估偏低
F5，-20.4%，下修明年成長預估

zh: 原油仍在 100 美元上方：WTI 約 101.9 至 102.8 美元（各來源盤中與收盤數字不一），布蘭特約 111 美元；美國警告中期選舉後可能對伊朗有新一輪打擊，支撐油價。十年期殖利率約 5.03% 至 5.05%，黃金約 4,050 至 4,080 美元。油價與殖利率同時偏高，是目前壓著成長股估值的兩個背景。
en: Crude stayed above $100: WTI was about $101.9 to $102.8 depending on the source and timing, and Brent about $111; the US warned of possible new strikes on Iran after the midterm elections, which supports oil. The 10-year yield was around 5.03% to 5.05% and gold around $4,050 to $4,080. High oil and high yields together remain the backdrop weighing on growth-stock valuations.

stocks.n: 原油 ETF，WTI 約 102 美元
黃金 ETF，金價約 4,050 至 4,080 美元
7 至 10 年期美債 ETF，殖利率貼近 5%

zh: 報導稱 SK 海力士季度營收年增 328%、營業利潤年增 632%（Yahoo Finance 整理的數字偏誇張，建議對照公司公告），帶動南韓市場；美股方面美光上漲約 5.9%，Flex 因上調 2027 財年每股盈餘預期上漲 11.6%。記憶體與電子製造的上游訊號偏強，與前一天晶片股反彈的方向一致。
en: Reports said SK Hynix's quarterly revenue rose 328% and operating profit rose 632% year over year (the figures compiled by Yahoo Finance look extreme, so check the company filing), lifting Korean shares; in the US Micron gained about 5.9% and Flex rose 11.6% after raising its fiscal 2027 EPS outlook. Upstream memory and electronics-manufacturing signals look strong, consistent with the prior day's chip rebound.

stocks.n: 美光，約 +5.9%，跟隨 SK 海力士
Flex，+11.6%，上調 2027 財年每股盈餘預期

zh: 微軟公布財報：調整後每股盈餘 4.89 美元（預期約 4.72 至 4.73），營收 922.8 億美元（年增 19%，預期約 906 億至 907 億），雲端營收 639 億美元；Azure 成長 48%，高於公司自己預估的 44% 至 45%。資本支出 452 億美元。盤後股價上漲約 2.4% 至 4%，市場獎勵的是雲端成長超出預期。
en: Microsoft reported adjusted EPS of $4.89 (consensus about $4.72 to $4.73) on revenue of $92.28 billion, up 19% (consensus about $90.6 billion to $90.7 billion), with cloud revenue of $63.9 billion. Azure grew 48%, above the company's own 44% to 45% guide, and capital spending was $45.2 billion. The shares rose roughly 2.4% to 4% after hours, rewarding cloud growth that beat expectations.

stocks.n: 微軟，盤後約 +2.4% 至 +4%，Azure +48%

zh: Alphabet 盤後下跌約 8.6%：營收約 1,112 億美元大致符合預期，但每股盈餘 2.12 美元，遠低於預期的約 2.99 至 3.01 美元，淨利從去年同期的 349 億美元降到 261.7 億美元。據 StockTitan 整理，搜尋營收成長從 17% 放緩到 12%、資本支出 514 億美元；同一來源稱 Google Cloud 年增 103%，這個數字偏高，建議對照公司新聞稿。
en: Alphabet fell about 8.6% after hours: revenue of roughly $111.2 billion was broadly in line, but EPS of $2.12 was far below the roughly $2.99 to $3.01 consensus, and net income fell to $26.17 billion from $34.90 billion a year earlier. StockTitan's summary cites search growth slowing to 12% from 17% and capex of $51.4 billion; it also says Google Cloud grew 103%, a figure that looks too high and should be checked against the company release.

stocks.n: Alphabet，盤後約 -8.6%，每股盈餘大幅低於預期

zh: 資安廠 Fortinet 盤後暴跌約 25.6%：第三季營收年增 20% 至 20.8 億美元，並把 2026 年營收成長預估上調到 20%，但這是今年三次上調中幅度最小的一次，服務營收預估還被下修。其他盤後動向：二手車平台 Carvana 在營收創高後漲約 9.6%，eBay 營收成長 14% 後漲約 4.7%。
en: Cybersecurity group Fortinet plunged about 25.6% after hours: third-quarter revenue rose 20% to $2.08 billion and it lifted its 2026 revenue growth outlook to 20%, but that was the smallest of its three raises this year and the service revenue outlook was cut. Elsewhere, Carvana rose about 9.6% on record revenue and eBay about 4.7% after revenue grew 14%.

stocks.n: Fortinet，盤後約 -25.6%，上調幅度最小且下修服務營收
Carvana，盤後約 +9.6%，營收創高
eBay，盤後約 +4.7%，營收成長 14%

zh: 聯準會以 10 比 2 投票維持利率在 3.75% 至 4.00%，克里夫蘭聯銀總裁 Hammack 與理事 Cook 兩人投反對票，主張升息 0.25 個百分點。聲明稱經濟活動以強勁步伐擴張、通膨仍高。交易員預期 12 月 9 日升息的機率約 85%，並預期利率到 2027 年 9 月接近 4.7%。
en: The Fed voted 10 to 2 to hold its policy rate at 3.75% to 4.00%; Cleveland Fed President Hammack and Governor Cook dissented in favor of a quarter-point hike. The statement said activity is expanding at a strong pace and inflation remains elevated. Traders put the odds of a December 9 hike at about 85% and see the rate near 4.7% by September 2027.

stocks.n: 長天期美債 ETF，升息預期壓著長債
短天期美債 ETF，對政策利率最敏感

zh: 聯準會主席 Warsh 宣布 2027 年會少開一次政策會議，那一次改為討論長期策略，不表決利率也不發聲明；他表示一年八次會議是適當的頻率，並說「制定政策需要在及時、定期、資訊豐富的間隔下評估近期發展」。這是制度面的調整，對短線利率路徑沒有直接影響，但值得追蹤是否改變市場對聯準會溝通節奏的預期。
en: Fed Chair Warsh said the Fed will hold one fewer policy meeting in 2027; that meeting will focus on long-term strategy, with no rate vote or policy statement. He said eight meetings a year is the right frequency and that getting policy right involves assessing near-term developments at timely, regular, information-rich intervals. This is an institutional change with no direct effect on the near-term rate path, but worth watching for any shift in expectations about Fed communication.

stocks.n: 短天期美債 ETF，利率預期的觀察窗口
金融類股 ETF，對利率路徑最敏感的板塊之一

zh: 十年期殖利率升到約 5.03% 至 5.05%，加上升息預期，債務融資的 AI 資本支出多了一層利息成本的檢驗。微軟本季資本支出 452 億美元、Alphabet 514 億美元，市場對兩者反應截然不同；甲骨文則用「2029 財年自由現金流轉正並超過 300 億美元」的目標來安撫市場。殖利率站穩 5% 以上時，資本支出的報酬證據會被看得更嚴。
en: The 10-year yield rose to about 5.03% to 5.05%, and with hike expectations, debt-financed AI capital spending faces a higher interest-cost test. Microsoft spent $45.2 billion on capex this quarter and Alphabet $51.4 billion, and the market reacted very differently; Oracle calmed investors with a target of free cash flow above $30 billion in fiscal 2029. With yields holding above 5%, the evidence of returns on capex gets scrutinized harder.

stocks.n: 7 至 10 年期美債 ETF，十年期殖利率站上 5%
甲骨文，以自由現金流目標回應資本支出疑慮

zh: AI 資料中心的電力與散熱設備續強：Vertiv 第三季營收年增 61%，並上調全年預期；GE Vernova 第三季優於預期、上調 2026 年營收預期，同時宣布以 90 億美元收購 Trench Group。這類公司賣的是「蓋資料中心與電網」的鏟子，業績來自客戶的資本支出，所以也繫於客戶是否繼續花錢。
en: Power and cooling equipment for AI data centers stayed strong: Vertiv's third-quarter revenue rose 61% and it raised its full-year outlook; GE Vernova beat third-quarter estimates, raised its 2026 revenue view and agreed to buy Trench Group for $9 billion. These firms sell the shovels for data centers and the grid, so their results depend on customers continuing to spend.

stocks.n: Vertiv，beat and raise，單日 +16.6%
GE Vernova，上調營收預期並宣布 90 億美元收購

zh: 煉油股在高油價與高煉油利潤下繳出強勁成績：Phillips 66 第三季調整後每股盈餘 14.08 美元，遠高於預期的 11.73 美元；HF Sinclair（DINO）創下單季獲利紀錄並任命新執行長。能源板塊在盤中小幅領先，但油價若回落，煉油利潤是最先被重新定價的部分。
en: Refiners posted strong results on high oil prices and refining margins: Phillips 66's third-quarter adjusted EPS was $14.08 against an expected $11.73, and HF Sinclair (DINO) posted a record quarterly profit and named a new CEO. Energy was slightly ahead midday, but if oil retreats, refining margins are the first thing to be repriced.

stocks.n: Phillips 66，調整後每股盈餘 14.08 美元優於預期
HF Sinclair，單季獲利創紀錄
能源類股 ETF，盤中小幅領先

zh: 醫療是盤中領先的板塊（約 +1.04%）：禮來的 retatrutide 在大型糖尿病試驗中表現優於 Ozempic；Genmab 的癌症藥物在第三期試驗中將死亡風險降低 50%，股價大漲 28.3%；百健財報優於預期並上調全年每股盈餘預期。反面例子是波士頓科學下調 2026 年每股盈餘預期，顯示醫療內部仍是個別公司的故事。
en: Health care led midday (about +1.04%): Eli Lilly's retatrutide outperformed Ozempic in a large diabetes study; Genmab's cancer drug cut the risk of death by 50% in a phase 3 trial and the stock jumped 28.3%; Biogen beat estimates and raised its 2026 EPS outlook. On the other side, Boston Scientific cut its 2026 EPS guidance, a reminder that health care moves stock by stock.

stocks.n: 禮來，retatrutide 試驗結果，今天另有財報
Genmab，第三期試驗降低死亡風險 50%，+28.3%
百健，財報優於預期並上調預期
波士頓科學，下調 2026 年每股盈餘預期

zh: 羅素 2000 週三上漲 0.41% 收 2,830.51，略高於標普 500 的 0.28%，前一天是 2,818.87。小型股對利率最敏感，十年期殖利率站上 5% 又有升息預期，能守住漲幅算是不錯的訊號；不過有一則評論稱當天小型股走弱，與收盤表格不一致，建議以指數實際收盤為準。
en: The Russell 2000 gained 0.41% to 2,830.51 on Wednesday, slightly ahead of the S&P 500's 0.28%, from 2,818.87 the day before. Small caps are the most rate-sensitive, so holding gains with the 10-year above 5% and hike expectations is a decent sign; one commentary said small caps were weak that day, which conflicts with the closing table, so rely on the actual index close.

stocks.n: 標普小型 600 ETF，品質較高的小型股池

zh: 三則併購新聞同日出現：Trian 提議以每股 7.35 美元現金私有化溫蒂漢堡（約 14 億美元，非約束性），股價大漲 15.1%；Monomoy 對 LCI Industries 提出每股 101 美元的非約束性收購提議，股價漲 8.4%；Investrade 另記載 Ultralife 同意被 EnerSys 以每股 16 美元現金收購。非約束性提議不保證成交，股價通常會停在出價之下。
en: Three takeover items surfaced on the same day: Trian proposed taking Wendy's private at $7.35 per share in cash (about $1.4 billion, non-binding), and the stock jumped 15.1%; Monomoy made a non-binding $101-per-share offer for LCI Industries, up 8.4%; Investrade also records Ultralife agreeing to be acquired by EnerSys for $16 per share in cash. Non-binding proposals do not guarantee a deal, and shares usually trade below the offer.

stocks.n: 溫蒂漢堡，Trian 每股 7.35 美元現金提議，+15.1%
LCI Industries，Monomoy 每股 101 美元提議，+8.4%
Ultralife，同意以每股 16 美元現金被收購

zh: 神經修復醫材商 Axogen 第三季營收 7,580 萬美元，年增 26.2%，把全年營收預估上調到至少成長 29%（約 2.9 億美元）；調整後 EBITDA 1,340 萬美元，去年同期 920 萬美元，毛利率則從 76.6% 降到 74.8%。公司增資後現金增至 3.5 億美元，用於 10 月 1 日完成的 BioCircuit 收購。股價單日漲 31.5%，這類大漲後要留意增資稀釋。
en: Nerve-repair device maker Axogen reported third-quarter revenue of $75.8 million, up 26.2%, and raised its full-year outlook to at least 29% growth (about $290 million); adjusted EBITDA was $13.4 million versus $9.2 million a year ago, while gross margin slipped to 74.8% from 76.6%. Cash rose to $350.1 million after an equity offering that funded the BioCircuit acquisition closed October 1. The stock jumped 31.5%, and after such moves dilution from equity raises deserves attention.

stocks.n: Axogen，營收 +26.2%，全年預估上調
OrthoPediatrics，另據 StockTitan 單日約 +29.3%（創紀錄營收）

zh: 太陽能族群走弱：微型逆變器大廠 Enphase 下跌約 16%，第三季每股盈餘不如預期，第四季營收預估 2.25 億至 2.55 億美元遠低於預期；SolarEdge 同日下跌約 8.3%，StockTitan 沒有找到公司公告可解釋。這類股票對利率與補貼政策都很敏感，十年期殖利率在 5% 以上時估值壓力更大。
en: Solar names weakened: microinverter maker Enphase fell about 16% after missing third-quarter EPS and guiding fourth-quarter sales to $225 million to $255 million, well below expectations; SolarEdge fell about 8.3% the same day, with no company announcement found to explain it. These stocks are sensitive to both interest rates and subsidy policy, and valuation pressure is greater with the 10-year above 5%.

stocks.n: Enphase，約 -16%，第四季營收預估低於預期
SolarEdge，約 -8.3%，未找到公司消息

zh: 小型股單日動輒 15% 至 40% 的漲跌，常見原因有三種：財測或財報落差（Landstar 因保險成本下跌 17.8%）、募資稀釋（Rapport 以每股 21 美元發行約 1.75 億美元新股後跌 18.3%）、以及生技的試驗結果（Bicara 單日跌 44.2%，StockTitan 沒找到原因）。看到大漲大跌先找「公告了什麼」，找不到原因就不要當成訊號，因為薄量股票的價格本來就會被少數交易推動。
en: Single-day moves of 15% to 40% in small caps usually come from three sources: guidance or earnings gaps (Landstar fell 17.8% on insurance costs), dilution (Rapport fell 18.3% after pricing a roughly $175 million offering at $21), and biotech trial results (Bicara fell 44.2% with no reason found by StockTitan). When you see a big move, find out what was announced first; if no reason can be found, do not treat it as a signal, since thinly traded stocks can be moved by a few trades.

stocks.n: Rapport Therapeutics，-18.3%，每股 21 美元增資
Landstar，-17.8%，保險成本壓低獲利
生技 ETF，小型生技波動的觀察窗口

zh: Gentherm（THRM，座椅與熱管理系統供應商）10/22 公布第三季：營收 4.051 億美元、年增 4.7%，GAAP 淨損 260 萬美元（去年同期獲利 1,490 萬美元），調整後每股盈餘 0.33 美元，去年同期 0.73 美元。公司 10 月已買回 6,000 萬美元的股票，授權額度還剩約 3.4 億美元。內部人買進一事有衝突：Monitor Insiders 列出 10/23 兩位內部人以 26.50 美元買進約 66.3 萬美元，Quiver 的摘要則稱過去 6 個月沒有買進，需查 EDGAR。風險：獲利明顯下滑，回購不等於基本面改善。本卡是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Gentherm (THRM, seat and thermal-management supplier) reported third-quarter results on 10/22: revenue of $405.1 million, up 4.7%, a GAAP net loss of $2.6 million (versus $14.9 million profit a year earlier), and adjusted EPS of $0.33 versus $0.73. It repurchased $60 million of stock in October with about $340 million of authorization remaining. Insider buying is disputed: Monitor Insiders lists two insiders buying about $663,000 at $26.50 on 10/23, while a Quiver summary says no purchases in six months, so check EDGAR. Risk: earnings fell sharply, and buybacks do not equal improving fundamentals. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

stocks.n: Gentherm，營收 4.051 億美元，調整後每股盈餘 0.33 美元，10 月回購 6,000 萬美元

status: RADAR · 下一個驗證點 EDGAR 確認內部人買進

zh: Regional Management（RM，美國小額消費貸款業者）原訂 10/28 盤後公布第三季，我們搜尋時尚未找到結果，今天先列驗證點：第二季淨利 820 萬美元、每股盈餘 0.85 美元，分別年減約 19.6% 與 17.5%；去年第三季每股盈餘 1.42 美元，是對照基期。Simply Wall St 的 10 月小型股名單把它列為有內部人活動的低估標的，但那是機器產生的篩選，不等於分析。風險：消費信貸損失率與融資成本。本卡是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Regional Management (RM, a US small-loan consumer lender) was scheduled to report third-quarter results after the close on 10/28; we could not find the results at search time, so today's card lists what to check: second-quarter net income was $8.2 million and EPS $0.85, down about 19.6% and 17.5%, and last year's third-quarter EPS of $1.42 is the base. Simply Wall St's October small-cap list flags it as undervalued with insider activity, but that is an automated screen, not analysis. Risks: credit losses and funding costs. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

stocks.n: Regional Management，第三季財報結果待確認，第二季每股盈餘 0.85 美元

zh: 據 Monitor Insiders 的群聚買進表，產權保險業者 Stewart Information Services（STC）有 5 位內部人在 10/23 以每股 46.10 美元買進，合計約 46.1 萬美元，10/27 申報。人數多是優點，但平均每人約 9 萬美元，金額不算大。判讀前要到 EDGAR 確認交易代碼是公開市場買進（P），並看買的人是誰、職位為何。
en: According to Monitor Insiders' cluster table, five insiders at title insurer Stewart Information Services (STC) bought at $46.10 per share on 10/23 for about $461,000 in total, filed 10/27. The number of buyers is a plus, but the average of roughly $90,000 each is not large. Before reading anything into it, confirm on EDGAR that the transaction code is an open-market purchase (P) and see who bought and in what role.

stocks.n: Stewart Information Services，5 位內部人，每股 46.10 美元，約 46.1 萬美元

zh: Northpointe Bancshares（NPB）的董事長暨執行長 Williams 8/25 以每股 16.95 美元買進 3 萬股（約 50.9 萬美元），Benzinga 另列 9/1 他的信託以 16.74 美元買進 8.5 萬股（約 140 萬美元）；Monitor Insiders 另列 10/23 有 3 位內部人以 15.38 美元買進約 177 萬美元。這些來源的時間與總額對不太起來，需以 EDGAR 的 Form 4 為準；若屬實，是股價在 15 美元附近時持續加碼，比單次買進更有參考價值。
en: Northpointe Bancshares (NPB) chairman and CEO Williams bought 30,000 shares at $16.95 on 8/25 (about $509,000), Benzinga also lists his trust buying 85,000 shares at $16.74 on 9/1 (about $1.4 million), and Monitor Insiders lists three insiders buying about $1.77 million at $15.38 on 10/23. These sources do not line up on dates and totals, so rely on the Form 4 filings on EDGAR; if accurate, repeated buying as the stock approached $15 is more informative than a single purchase.

stocks.n: Northpointe Bancshares，執行長多次買進，價格約 15 至 17 美元

zh: 各網站對「群聚買進」的定義不同，有的只要兩位內部人在兩週內買進就算，標準比分析師常用的三位以上寬鬆。小額買進（例如 Anixa Biosciences 兩位內部人 10/22 至 10/23 以每股 2.85 美元買進約 4.6 萬美元）訊號很弱，微型股流動性差，少量資金就能撐起這個數字。篩選頁面也常混入封閉式基金，要先排除。
en: Websites define a cluster buy differently; some count any two insiders buying within two weeks, looser than the three or more analysts often use. Small purchases (for example, two Anixa Biosciences insiders buying about $46,000 at $2.85 on 10/22 to 10/23) are weak signals, and micro-cap illiquidity means little money can produce those numbers. Screener pages also mix in closed-end funds, which should be excluded first.

stocks.n: Anixa Biosciences，兩位內部人，每股 2.85 美元，約 4.6 萬美元

zh: 這次沒有找到「部位有明確主題」的政要申報，所以只寫判讀。第三方追蹤站列出的 10 月申報多是 1,001 至 15,000 美元的小額買賣（例如 Larsen 10/12、Khanna 10/7）；Pelosi 最近一次股票申報是 8/21，內容為 Bloom Energy 與 Intel 的股票和買權，已經過了兩個多月。申報最多可延遲 45 天、金額只有區間，所以這些資料適合看「有人在押什麼主題」，不適合當買賣訊號。
en: No disclosure with a clearly themed position turned up this time, so this card is interpretation only. Third-party trackers list October filings that are mostly small trades of $1,001 to $15,000 (for example Larsen on 10/12 and Khanna on 10/7); Pelosi's latest stock filing was 8/21, covering Bloom Energy and Intel shares and call options, now more than two months old. Filings can lag by up to 45 days and report only ranges, so this data is better for seeing what theme someone is backing than as a trading signal.

stocks.n: Bloom Energy，Pelosi 8/21 申報的股票與買權

zh: 今天早上 8:30（美東）公布第三季 GDP 初值，同時公布 9 月個人所得與支出（含 PCE）；有來源預期核心 PCE 年增 3.1%，高於前值 3.0%，不同來源的預估不一致，請以公布值為準。聯準會剛表態維持利率但保留升息選項，這兩份數據會直接影響 12 月 9 日升息的預期。下一次 FOMC 是 12 月 8 至 9 日。
en: This morning at 8:30 a.m. ET the first estimate of third-quarter GDP is released along with September personal income and spending (including PCE); one source expects core PCE at 3.1% year over year, up from 3.0%, though forecasts differ by source, so rely on the actual prints. The Fed just held rates while keeping a hike on the table, so these two reports bear directly on expectations for a December 9 hike. The next FOMC meeting is December 8 to 9.

stocks.n: 標普 500 ETF，數據公布後的反應指標
長天期美債 ETF，PCE 影響升息預期

zh: 今天開盤前有禮來、卡特彼勒、萬事達卡、默克與殼牌；盤後是亞馬遜，來源預估每股盈餘約 1.96 至 2.01 美元、營收約 2,020 億美元，焦點是 AWS 成長與 AI 資本支出，英特爾與 Sandisk 在部分行事曆也列在盤後（各來源名單不一致）。目前標普 500 公司約有一半以下已公布，83% 優於盈餘預期，去年同期是 87%。
en: Before the open today: Eli Lilly, Caterpillar, Mastercard, Merck and Shell; after the close, Amazon, with sources estimating EPS of about $1.96 to $2.01 on revenue of roughly $202 billion, focusing on AWS growth and AI capex; Intel and Sandisk are also listed after the close on some calendars, and lists differ by source. Fewer than half of S&P 500 companies have reported, and 83% have beaten EPS estimates versus 87% a year ago.

zh: 把今天放在一起：微軟 Azure 成長 48%、股價盤後漲；Alphabet 營收符合預期卻因每股盈餘大幅落後盤後跌約 8.6%，而同一時間十年期殖利率站上 5%、市場預期 12 月升息機率約 85%。同樣是砸下 450 億至 510 億美元的資本支出，市場願意為「看得見報酬」付價，卻不容許獲利落差。今天亞馬遜盤後財報，是下一個檢驗。
en: Putting it together: Microsoft's Azure grew 48% and the stock rose after hours; Alphabet's revenue was in line but EPS missed badly and the stock fell about 8.6% after hours, while the 10-year yield is above 5% and markets price about 85% odds of a December hike. With both spending $45 billion to $51 billion on capex, the market pays for visible returns but does not tolerate an earnings gap. Amazon reports after the close today, the next test.

stocks.n: 微軟，Azure +48%
Alphabet，每股盈餘落後
